parts.title: TheOneApp Promotional Video 1: The Forgetting Fog
parts.description:
When the Forgetting Fog rolls in, Pip, Momo and Basil must work out why the light has gone, and fix an open circuit to bring it back. A short adventure from TheOneApp, the science study app for Primary 3 to 6 in Singapore.

Parents: see TheOneApp and try it free for 7 days at https://theoneapp.sg

The only app you need to learn Science: TheOneApp.
